zh-CN.title: 管理，更有条理
items: 空间管理按成员、社区、运营、设置与访问控制重新分组，常用功能直接在面板中操作
超级管理员采用两级导航，拆分邮件投递、邮件审阅和诊断详情，适配横竖屏

en.title: A clearer administration workspace
items: Space administration is organized around people, community, engagement, settings and access, with everyday tools directly in the main panel
Platform administration gains two-level navigation, separate delivery and review pages, and contextual diagnostics across portrait and landscape layouts
